from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")// Try this bucket first
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "HYPERLIQUID_BTCUSD-PERP_binance_mid_GridOL_EmaRelValStableRatio")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> timeShift(duration: -60s)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)  
  |> yield(name: "last")
  // Remove aggregation window temporarily to see if raw data exists
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

// Get the non-shifted signal data
nonShiftedSignal = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "signal")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "signal"})

// Time-shifted mid price calculation with variable for timeshift
timeShiftedMid = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> timeShift(duration: duration(v: "${walkahead}"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       shifted_mid: (r.bid + r.ask) / 2.0
     }))

// Calculate the cumulative difference
join(tables: {sig: nonShiftedSignal, mid: timeShiftedMid}, on: ["_time", "strategy"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       walkahead: r.shifted_mid - r.signal
     }))
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["walkahead"])
  |> set(key: "timeshift", value: "${walkahead}")

// Get the non-shifted signal data
nonShiftedSignal = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "signal")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "signal"})

// Get mid price calculation without timeshift
midPrice = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       mid: (r.bid + r.ask) / 2.0
     }))

// Join the signal and mid price data
joined = join(tables: {sig: nonShiftedSignal, mid: midPrice}, on: ["_time", "strategy"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       signal: r.signal,
       mid: r.mid,
       diff: r.signal - r.mid
     }))

// Use a sliding window approach with a fixed duration
// Parse walkahead as a duration (assuming it's formatted like "1h", "30m", etc.)
lookbackInterval = duration(v: "${walkahead}")

joined
  |> window(every: $__interval, period: lookbackInterval)
  |> sum(column: "diff")
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> set(key: "walkahead", value: "${walkahead}")

// Get the non-shifted signal data
nonShiftedSignal = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.strategy, set: ${Strategy:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "signal")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "signal"})

// Get current mid price
currentMid = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.strategy, set: ${Strategy:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "strategy"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       current_mid: (r.bid + r.ask) / 2.0
     }))

// Get future mid price (time-shifted by walkahead)
futureMid = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.strategy, set: ${Strategy:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> timeShift(duration: duration(v: "${walkahead}"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "strategy"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       future_mid: (r.bid + r.ask) / 2.0
     }))

// First join signal and current mid
signalAndCurrentMid = join(
  tables: {sig: nonShiftedSignal, cur_mid: currentMid},
  on: ["_time", "strategy"]
)

// Then join with future mid, calculate the conditional difference
// and keep only the necessary fields
join(
  tables: {combined: signalAndCurrentMid, fut_mid: futureMid},
  on: ["_time", "strategy"]
)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      signal_mid_diff = r.signal - r.current_mid
      
      return {
        _time: r._time,
        strategy: r.strategy,
        // If signal - mid is negative, use future_mid - current_mid
        // If signal - mid is positive, use current_mid - future_mid
        // If signal - mid is exactly 0, use 0
        varad_walkahead: if signal_mid_diff == 0.0
                        then 0.0
                        else if signal_mid_diff > 0.0 
                              then r.future_mid - r.current_mid 
                              else r.current_mid - r.future_mid
      }
  })
  |> group(columns: ["strategy"])
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["varad_walkahead"])
  |> set(key: "walkahead", value: "${walkahead}")

// Convert walkahead to a duration
walkDuration = duration(v: "${walkahead}")

// Get current bid, ask data for time t
currentPrices = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       bid_t: r.bid,
       ask_t: r.ask,
       mid_t: (r.bid + r.ask) / 2.0
     }))

// Get historical data (walkahead time earlier)
historicalData = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(
       start: experimental.subDuration(
         d: walkDuration,
         from: v.timeRangeStart
       ),
       stop: experimental.subDuration(
         d: walkDuration,
         from: v.timeRangeStop
       )
     )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "strategy"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
       // If signal columns don't exist, create them from the signal
       bid_signal = if exists r.bidSignal then r.bidSignal else r.signal
       ask_signal = if exists r.askSignal then r.askSignal else r.signal
       
       return {
         _time: experimental.addDuration(
           d: walkDuration,
           to: r._time
         ),  // Shift time forward to align with current time
         strategy: r.strategy,
         bid_signal: bid_signal,
         ask_signal: ask_signal,
         bid_hist: r.bid,
         ask_hist: r.ask
       }
     })

// Join historical signals with current prices
join(
  tables: {hist: historicalData, curr: currentPrices},
  on: ["_time", "strategy"]
)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
       // Apply the logic as described
       value = if r.bid_signal > r.ask_hist then
                 r.bid_signal - r.mid_t
               else if r.ask_signal < r.bid_hist then
                 r.mid_t - r.ask_signal
               else
                 0.0
                 
       return {
         _time: r._time,
         strategy: r.strategy,
         value: value
       }
     })
  |> window(every: $__interval)
  |> sum(column: "value")
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> set(key: "walkahead", value: "${walkahead}")

// Get the non-shifted signal data
nonShiftedSignal = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "signal")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "signal"})

// Get current mid price
currentMid = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       current_mid: (r.bid + r.ask) / 2.0
     }))

// Get future mid price (time-shifted by walkahead)
futureMid = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy == "${Strategy}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> timeShift(duration: duration(v: "${walkahead}"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       future_mid: (r.bid + r.ask) / 2.0
     }))

// First join signal and current mid
signalAndCurrentMid = join(
  tables: {sig: nonShiftedSignal, cur_mid: currentMid},
  on: ["_time", "strategy"]
)

// Then join with future mid and calculate the conditional difference
join(
  tables: {combined: signalAndCurrentMid, fut_mid: futureMid},
  on: ["_time", "strategy"]
)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       signal: r.signal,
       current_mid: r.current_mid,
       future_mid: r.future_mid,
       signal_mid_diff: r.signal - r.current_mid,
       // If signal - mid is negative, use future_mid - current_mid
       // Otherwise, use current_mid - future_mid
       conditional_diff: if r.signal - r.current_mid < 0.0 
                         then r.future_mid - r.current_mid 
                         else r.current_mid - r.future_mid
     }))
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["conditional_diff"])
  |> set(key: "walkahead", value: "${walkahead}")

// Get all the data we need in a single query
allData = from(bucket: "signals_db/default_signals_retention")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "StrategySignal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.strategy, set: ${Strategy:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "signal" or r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  // Aggregate early to reduce data points being processed
  |> aggregateWindow(every: $__interval, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

// Separate signals from bid/ask
signalData = allData
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "signal")
  |> drop(columns: ["_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "signal"})

// Process current mid price
midData = allData
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bid" or r._field == "ask")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "strategy"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       _time: r._time,
       strategy: r.strategy,
       current_mid: (r.bid + r.ask) / 2.0
     }))
  |> drop(columns: ["bid", "ask"])

// Get future mid price using duplicate of midData and timeShift
futureMidData = midData
  |> timeShift(duration: duration(v: "-${walkahead}"))
  |> rename(columns: {current_mid: "future_mid"})

// Join signals and current mid
signalAndMid = join(
  tables: {sig: signalData, mid: midData},
  on: ["_time", "strategy"]
)

// Join with future mid and calculate
result = join(
  tables: {sm: signalAndMid, fm: futureMidData},
  on: ["_time", "strategy"]
)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      signal_mid_diff = r.signal - r.current_mid
      
      return {
        _time: r._time,
        strategy: r.strategy,
        varad_walkahead: if signal_mid_diff == 0.0
                        then 0.0
                        else if signal_mid_diff > 0.0 
                              then r.future_mid - r.current_mid 
                              else r.current_mid - r.future_mid
      }
  })
  |> group(columns: ["strategy"])
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["varad_walkahead"])
  |> set(key: "walkahead", value: "${walkahead}")
